name: FilmLab
description: Ultra-realistic 35mm analog film simulation lab featuring calibrated Kodachrome 64, Portra 400, Fuji Velvia 50, CineStill 800T, Fuji Pro 400H, Ilford HP5, and Kodak Tri-X 400 presets with precision sensitometry, dye coupling, grain physics, vertical photo framing, and fold-aware layouts for foldable phones.
